user.title: Configure ha-dtek
user.description: Choose your regional DTEK provider and setup method.

address.title: Enter Address
address.description: Enter the city, street, and house number to automatically resolve your outage queue and planned maintenance.

manual_group.title: Manual Queue Selection
manual_group.description: Enter your DTEK stabilization schedule group (e.g. GPV1.2).

new_cabinet.title: New DTEK portal login (Dnipro)
new_cabinet.description: Use your my.dtek-dnem.com.ua credentials. Complete required password or phone changes on the website first.

new_account.title: Choose your account
new_account.description: Select your account and enter your confirmed outage queue. The new portal does not provide a verified outage queue API.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your DTEK account
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your Personal Cabinet phone number and password for the selected portal. Only these credentials will be updated; your linked account and configuration will be preserved.

cabinet.title: DTEK Personal Cabinet Login
cabinet.description: Log in with your DTEK Personal Cabinet phone number and password.

error.new_portal_unsupported: The new portal is currently supported only for Dnipro.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to DTEK portal. Please check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid phone number or password for DTEK Personal Cabinet.
error.address_not_found: City or street was not found on DTEK portal.
error.house_not_found: House number was not found in the DTEK street listing.
error.no_account: The DTEK Personal Cabinet did not return an account for this login. Please verify your account in the DTEK portal and try again.
error.no_group: The outage queue (GPV) could not be determined for this account. Please try again later or use manual queue entry.

abort.already_configured: This DTEK location or queue is already configured.

init.title: DTEK Options
init.description: Adjust polling and optionally choose the new Dnipro portal. Selecting it validates the saved credentials against my.dtek. Public outage access is separate.

error.new_portal_unsupported: The new portal is supported only for Dnipro.
error.no_account: The linked account is not available with these credentials.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Verify the saved credentials and required account changes on the website.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the new DTEK portal.
error.unknown: Could not verify the new portal account or meter response.
